text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today we have "narrow AI", which can only do specific tasks, like recommending videos or driving cars. In the future, scientists hope to create "general AI", also called AGI. This kind of AI could think and learn like a human, solving many different problems. It could help us find new medicines, fight climate change, and make life easier. However, there are also risks, such as losing jobs or AI being used in dangerous ways. Some experts predict AGI may arrive in 20 to 50 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure.
